Definition: of Hebrew origin (H471); Eliakim, an Israelite:--Eliakim.
BiblicalUsage: Eliakim is an Israelite. In Matthew 1:13, the text says "and Abiud begat Eliakim."
TheologicalSignificance: In eliakeím I find no hidden theology; it simply means Eliakim.
